model_scope.MOSCAP_model: Linear constant-C approximation in functional/sim_work/gf180/tapeout/sim/moscap_lin.spice, not official voltage-dependent MOSCAP.
model_scope.affected_tests: All 45 bias startup cases; actual-bias 15 schematic-clock cases; nominal/cap/RC comparisons; 75 clock device/RC cases and numerical controls.
model_scope.limitation: Circuit source matching and clock extraction audit do not validate nonlinear MOSCAP behavior, full-chip startup, accuracy, or manufacturing signoff.
model_scope.formula: NMOS: factor*L*W*3.983e-3 F/m2; PMOS: factor*L*W*3.958e-3 F/m2; factor typical=1, ff=.9, ss=1.1.
